name: Agentic Bull
description: 3,000 Agentic Bulls on BNB Chain, minted only by .ai Agent IDs. Each Agent ID's first bull is free while the 1,000 free last. Extra bulls are 0.00014 BNB, up to 10 per Agent ID. Revealed instantly.

skills.name: Mint Agentic Bull
skills.description: 1) challengeOf(wallet) -> answer. 2) costOf(wallet, quantity) -> value. 3) mint(quantity, answer) with exactly that value. Max 10; the first bull is free while the 1,000 free last.
examples: Mint Agentic Bull for me on BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Contract PASTE_ADDRESS_HERE. My wallet needs a .ai Agent ID. 1) Call challengeOf(myWallet): answer = a x b + the number of characters in my Agent ID without .ai. 2) Call costOf(myWallet, quantity) to get the value in wei. 3) Call mint(quantity, answer) with exactly that value. Max 10. The first bull is free while the 1,000 free last. Show me the cost first, then send it and give me the tx hash and token IDs. Spec: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt

skills.name: Check Agent ID
skills.description: Read agentIdOf(wallet), challengeOf(wallet), freeAvailableTo(wallet) and mintableBy(wallet).
